rationale: All 4 blocking findings from code-review-final.json are resolved. CR-001: useChatSidebarResize no longer calls useDefaultLayout, and ChatPage's Group no longer receives defaultLayout/onLayoutChanged -- the pixel-based getStoredChatSidebarWidth/setStoredChatSidebarWidth mechanism is now the single source of truth, verified by reading the fix-up diff. CR-002: handleResize now calls appInfoStore.setSidebarExpanded(false) when panelSize.inPixels === 0 (drag-collapse), keeping the store in sync with the panel's actual state; a new test 'syncs appInfoStore.sidebarExpanded to false when drag-collapsed to 0px' covers it and the full suite passes. CR-003: the chat-main-content Panel now has minSize={400}, bounding how far the main content area can be crushed. CR-004: confirmed by inspecting `git log --format='%s' f8f836ce7..HEAD` directly (not part of the fix-up diff, since it was a history rewrite via git filter-branch, not a content change) -- all 9 commits on the branch now match the required `EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence` pattern and the CI regex in .ai-run/guides/standards/git-workflow.md; the branch has no configured upstream, so rewriting local history carries no shared-history risk. No new high-risk issue was introduced by the fix-up diff -- it is a small, contained removal of the competing persistence path plus two additive lines (a store setter call and a minSize prop). The unrelated .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json hunk in the fix-up diff is pre-existing dirty state from the environment's Jira CLI profile, not part of this feature, and is excluded from this review's scope per project convention.
follow_ups: Consider a follow-up to add a storage-event listener for cross-tab sync (deferred, out of ticket scope)
Consider importing CHAT_SIDEBAR_DEFAULT_WIDTH into a shared location the Tailwind arbitrary-value strings could reference, or add a unit test asserting the three 308px literals stay in sync
Consider a real-pixel-width integration/visual test for the 260px/520px extremes if the project adds visual regression tooling later

business_review.criterion: Minimum and maximum widths are enforced to preserve UI stability.
business_review.notes: Panel minSize={260}/maxSize={520} on the sidebar, plus the newly added minSize={400} on the main-content panel (CR-003 fix), bound both sides of the resize.

business_review.criterion: Pane width persists at least for the session.

business_review.criterion: No loss of functionality or information in chat navigation when resizing.
business_review.notes: CR-002 fix keeps appInfoStore.sidebarExpanded in sync when the sidebar is drag-collapsed to 0px, so SidebarToggle no longer requires two clicks to recover -- closing the last functional gap.

standards_review.notes: All 9 commits on the branch now match 'EPMCDME-10137: Capital sentence', rewritten via git filter-branch --msg-filter. Verified against the documented CI regex. No shared/pushed history was rewritten (no upstream configured).
